verdict.headline: Private apps can be shared directly via link with zero review required, while public Marketplace apps require up to 21 business days of formal review.
verdict.timeToFirstConnection: 15–30 minutes to set up a private app and test local OAuth redirection.
verdict.timeToProduction: Same day for private unlisted apps shared via direct link; up to 21 business days if submitting for the public Marketplace.
verdict.handsOnEffort: Minimal hands-on setup for private apps; extensive media assets, video demos, and test accounts required for public Marketplace review.
verdict.cost: Free to register and use custom OAuth apps; API rate limits apply based on the customer's Pipedrive subscription plan.
verdict.biggestRisk: Scope updates invalidate existing user tokens requiring complete re-installation, and changing scopes in the authorization URL manually triggers consent errors.

ownAppDecision.summary: You must register your own OAuth application in Pipedrive's Developer Hub and pass credentials to Composio.
reasons: Pipedrive requires custom OAuth apps for custom scopes and external redirect handling.
Private apps allow immediate distribution via shareable install links without going through Pipedrive's review process.
Per-customer dynamic API routing relies on returning specific api_domain attributes per account during token exchange.

phases.name: Prepare Development Account & Scope Plan
phases.goal: Set up a Pipedrive sandbox or developer company account and map out required API scopes.

steps.title: Access Pipedrive developer environment
steps.detail: Log into your Pipedrive account or use a Pipedrive sandbox environment for testing.

steps.title: Define required scopes
steps.detail: Determine exact entity permissions required by your agent (e.g., base, contacts:read, search:read, admin).
steps.agentHelp: Analyze application feature requirements to recommend minimal required scopes.

phases.name: Create App & Implement OAuth 2.0 Flow
phases.goal: Obtain client credentials, configure redirect URIs, and complete the token exchange code.

steps.title: Register Private App in Developer Settings
steps.detail: Navigate to Marketplace settings in Pipedrive, create a new Private App, and configure the Callback URL.
steps.agentHelp: Validate callback URLs and check ngrok tunnel formatting for local development.

steps.title: Configure OAuth scopes in Developer Hub
steps.detail: Select necessary scopes directly in the app settings UI; do not append scope parameters to authorization URLs.
steps.agentHelp: Ensure scope settings match the code defaults to prevent consent error triggers.

steps.title: Implement Authorization & Token Exchange
steps.detail: Direct users to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/authorize and exchange codes at POST https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token.
steps.agentHelp: Generate token exchange logic, store refresh tokens, and handle base api_domain routing dynamically.

phases.name: Distribute App or Submit for Review
phases.goal: Deploy the application to production end-users either via direct install link or Marketplace review.
phases.duration: Same day (Private) or up to 21 business days (Public Marketplace)

steps.title: Distribute via Private Installation Link
steps.detail: Set Private App status to 'Live' and copy the shareable installation link for your customers.
steps.agentHelp: Draft user-facing installation instructions and link documentation.

steps.title: Submit Public App for Review (Optional)
steps.detail: Provide terms of service, privacy policy, demo video, screenshots, and review credentials if publishing publicly.
steps.agentHelp: Draft privacy policy summaries, video demonstration scripts, and submission forms.

phases.name: Token Refresh & Rate Limit Handling
phases.goal: Ensure uninterrupted API connectivity with token refresh handling and rate limit monitoring.

steps.title: Automate Token Refreshing
steps.detail: Refresh access tokens prior to their 60-minute expiration and ensure refresh tokens are used within 60 days.
steps.agentHelp: Implement refresh logic background routines and handle 401 error retry states.

steps.title: Monitor API Rate Limits
steps.detail: Track daily token consumption budgets and handle 429 Too Many Requests response status codes.
steps.agentHelp: Implement backoff strategies and check daily budget remaining headers.

requirements.detail: Requires an explicit HTTPS callback URI (e.g. via ngrok tunnel during development) matching the exact configured setting.
A standard Pipedrive account or developer sandbox account is required to create and host OAuth apps.
Required publicly accessible web pages for Public Marketplace app review submission.
Public marketplace apps require 3–5 annotated screenshots and a detailed scope explanation demo video.

permissions.name: base
permissions.purpose: Identify current authorized user details and account base currencies.
permissions.notes: Enabled by default for all created Pipedrive OAuth applications.

permissions.name: contacts:read
permissions.purpose: Read contacts, persons, organizations, notes, and files.
permissions.notes: Allows AI agents to contextually read CRM contact data.

permissions.name: search:read
permissions.purpose: Perform global searches across Pipedrive CRM entities.
permissions.notes: Enables agent query and global search capabilities.

permissions.name: recents:read
permissions.purpose: Fetch recent changes across activities, deals, and contacts.
permissions.notes: Useful for sync workflows and identifying newly updated records.

permissions.name: admin
permissions.purpose: Full administrative read/write access to settings, webhooks, users, and pipelines.
permissions.notes: Requires the authorizing user to possess administrative privileges in their Pipedrive company.

nuances.title: Per-Customer API Domains
nuances.detail: Pipedrive routes API calls to account-specific domains returned as api_domain in the token exchange payload.

nuances.title: Scopes Configured via UI Only
nuances.detail: Scopes are configured statically in the Developer Hub; passing scope parameters in authorization URLs causes errors or mismatches.

nuances.title: Scope Updates Invalidate Tokens
nuances.detail: Changing application permissions requires all previously authorized users to uninstall and reinstall the application.

blockers.symptom: Users see an error modal during OAuth authorization saying 'App permissions have changed. Refresh this page'.
blockers.howToProceed: Remove the scope query parameter entirely from your authorization URL, as scopes must be managed solely in Developer Hub UI.

blockers.symptom: External account users receive an 'App is not found' error when attempting OAuth consent.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure private apps are marked 'Live' or switch to private install links rather than testing across accounts with Draft public apps.
